text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
O... Ooh? Royce, isn't this looking pretty 
good?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, she's playing the main melody!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is...! There's a chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, can I actually do this? I 
can... I can totally do it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce wins it! Becoming the 
first Aoba Sho winner in history to 
triumph at the Japanese Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah......... Did I, win? I... 
won, didn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "No way! For real!?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Unquestionably, the victory 
belongs to you— congratulations...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Chitose O-san...! If you say so, Chitose 
O-san, then it must be true!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's not a dream... I'm... a Derby Uma 
Musume...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The "Strongest of the Generation"...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
W-We did iiiiiiiit!! A GⅠ victory! We 
conquered the Japanese Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Royce is dancing a little!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I totally get how you feel! This is a 
tremendous feat! I feel like dancing right 
alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawa, we've gotta celebrate this! 
Cake! Should we buy a whole cake!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, before that, the concert! The 
Winning Live—c-center stage?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this melody of delight and chaos... 
What a thrilling, exhilarating piece of 
music!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Royce-chaaan! Congrats on becoming a Derby 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ――Ah! E-Everyone... thank you so――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it over...? Is this really the end? 
The Derby... My Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win, I wanted to win, I wanted 
to win!! Waaaahhhhh, waaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ———— ...Don't cry, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even if we cry... it won't undo it. ...We 
lost, dammit—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, I too... felt that if I were to 
lose, it would be to one of you two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...How foolish. That is precisely why you 
lost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
――Let's both get stronger. There's still 
the autumn season ahead.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Taishin... Hayahideee... Aaaah... 
*waaaaahhhhh*!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ticket-zo...’ ‘Ticket-zo...!’ ‘Ugh..., 
Ticket-zo!!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ticket-zo!! Autumn... there's still 
autumn!’ ‘I'm going to watch the Kikuka 
Sho! I'll definitely be there cheering for 
you!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WOOOAAAAAH!"

As if giving voice to her bitter 
disappointment, the crowd's cries tore 
through the sky.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you've got to be kidding...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Why!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I'm the one who won...! Even 
though I'm the first in history to win 
both the Aoba Sho and the Japan Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san stole the whole show...!

Her goal of being the "strongest" means 
becoming an Umamusume who will remain in 
people's memories and be talked about for 
generations.

The one who captured the hearts of the 
spectators and left the deepest impression 
in today's Japanese Derby was—

text_block_list.name: Sports Newspaper Article
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dreams shattered... Winning Ticket weeps 
uncontrollably! Though she fought 
alongside Hayahide and Taishin, it ends in 
bitter regret. Overcoming this hardship 
with her friends, she heads towards 
autumn—’"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Derby, BNW's friendship made me 
cry.’ ‘I'm worried about Ticket-zo's 
mental state...’ ‘BNW's showdown still has 
the Kikuka Sho!’"

"BNW is an acronym referring to Biwa 
Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning 
Ticket. Lately, that nickname is beginning 
to take root."

"And the public response to the Japanese 
Derby was overwhelmingly focused on the 
BNW trio."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...To think achieving a historic first 
would be overshadowed by pure impression.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I set everything up, right 
down to the drama of her setback at the 
Satsuki Sho, as part of my production..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If this still loses out on impact, what am 
I supposed to do?! I'm totally out of 
options!
choice_data_list:
Let's think about it together! There has 
to be a way!

Let's think about it together! There's got 
to be a way!

text_block_list.text:
She threw herself into her training with 
great fervor, while also rushing around 
handling her self-production.

She puts in twice the effort of other 
Umamusume. I want to give her results that 
truly match that dedication.

—Isn't there anything? Some way to make 
the existence of Rice Shower stand out 
even more...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for giving up so easily. 
Thinking—that's it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"My weapon is this brain of mine. 
Thinking, thinking, and thinking 
everything through."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll find a path to becoming the 
"strongest"...!
choice_data_list: I'll think of a way too!
I'll think of a way too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If the two of you compare your 
ideas, it might lead to new realizations.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's reset and refocus!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, the reason we lost in terms of 
impact is quite clear.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san's interview. She talked about 
how, before the Derby, she was feeling 
down until Hayahide-san and Taishin-san 
cheered her up, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And from there, the conversation broadened 
to how we've pushed each other as friends 
and rivals ever since we first enrolled.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it even made it into an online news 
article.
Yeah, it even made the online news.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That drama about friendship delivered the 
final blow.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Friendship with a rival—now that's true 
youth! The classic sports anime trope! No 
wonder she's so strong!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... BNW already has the ability, and 
now they've got youth drama on top of 
it...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A simple touching drama about a 
hardworking Umamusume isn't going to be 
enough to win on its own.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, the teen drama is just too 
strong. You won't easily find anything 
that can beat it—

"As long as they hold the ultimate trump 
card known as 'youth,' we have no chance 
of winning."
choice_data_list: ...Hm? But is it really necessary to win?
...Hm? But do you really have to win?

text_block_list.text:
The goal is to create a drama that 
captivates hearts. Wouldn't it be fine to 
play our strongest card together and leave 
a lasting impression?
choice_data_list:
In other words, living out our youth with 
BNW!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ! Indeed...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, but still... Is there really a need to 
cling to youth to the point of recycling 
running gags—
choice_data_list:
It does! Youth hits adults right in the 
heart!

It does! Youth hits adults right in the 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: An adult? Why?
choice_data_list: Because you can relive the experience!

text_block_list.text:
The unique brilliance of youth that one 
only realizes as an adult. After-school 
hours spent with friends, and training 
camps that were both tough and fun.

The daily life we took for granted back 
then looks so bright and sparkling once 
you become an adult.

By watching teen drama shows, adults can 
relive memories and vicariously experience 
the youth they never had.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Is that so? I see, I see... 
Speaking from personal experience?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So its effectiveness is already proven! 
That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't have an adult's perspective, so 
that's super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Keep those kinds of opinions coming 
non-stop from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, change of plans! From now on, 
we're going with a refreshing, hot-blooded 
youth sports vibe!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And conveniently enough, we have summer 
training camp coming up—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It also doubles as a chance to gather 
intel for the next Kikuka Sho—two birds 
with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now, time to restart my self-producing!!
